purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define MeritCore as the owner of deterministic point calculation from accepted merit evidence while keeping relevance/ranking policy outside any hidden global weighting model. [2] Define deterministic MeritCore points as derived calculation over accepted evidence and explicit policy/profile rather than backend-assigned arbitrary values.

value.broker_rule: Broker/relevance policy may select or rank contextually relevant merit but does not silently rewrite global merit points.
value.decay_rule: There is no generic time decay; recency applies only when an explicit competence criterion requires it.
value.derived_rule: Points are derived MeritCore state, not raw backend evidence.
value.determinism_rule: Same accepted merit inputs and rule version produce the same points.
value.input_rule: Point calculation consumes explicit evidence/atoms and declared calculation rules.
value.owner_rule: MeritCore calculates points from accepted merit records.
value.presentation_rule: Displayed point totals are projections of MeritCore calculation.
value.recompute_rule: Recalculation uses exact evidence/policy revision and preserves historical evaluation evidence.
value.source_rule: Points derive from exact accepted Merit evidence.
value.time_rule: Week/hour atom conservation participates in point calculation.
value.version_rule: Calculation rule/version is explicit and traceable.

hard_gates.condition: points authored directly in Portfolio UI
generic time decay applied without competence rule
broker relevance silently mutates stored global points
backend writes arbitrary point total as truth
points derived from profile text heuristically

invariants.rule: MeritCore-derived points, Tier, recommendations and trust remain bound to one identity and explicit Project/evidence history; they cannot be manufactured by presentation, identity merging or time-splitting.

Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

references.purpose: Points derive from accepted merit evidence.
